name: speakeasy
description: Real-time voice-call translation messenger — Stage 0 skeleton (RU<->HE)

scripts.deps: npm run deps:backend && npm run deps:web && npm run deps:agent
scripts.deps:agent: cd agent && uv venv --python 3.13 && uv sync
scripts.dev:agent: cd agent && uv run python -m speakeasy_agent.main
scripts.demo:pipeline: cd agent && uv run python scripts/mock_pipeline_demo.py
scripts.clean:logs: find logs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log' -delete 2>/dev/null; echo 'service logs removed; logs/calls (eval data) kept — npm run clean:evals deletes those'
scripts.clean: npm run clean:logs && rm -rf backend/node_modules backend/dist web/node_modules web/dist agent/.venv agent/.pytest_cache && find agent -type d -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
